h1: Modena by Fraser Buriram — the 4-star hotel you can walk to Chang Arena from
intro: If you're coming to Buriram for a match at Chang Arena or a race at the Chang International Circuit, the first question is usually which hotel is genuinely close to the venue — Modena by Fraser Buriram is the answer guests mention most, because it's just a few minutes' walk from the lobby to the stadium. A 4-star hotel from Frasers Hospitality, opened in 2018, it has 152 rooms, two swimming pools and a 24-hour gym. Rooms start from approx. THB 1,290/night, breakfast included.

body.html: The selling point that puts Modena by Fraser Buriram near the top of the city's list is location — the hotel sits right next to Chang Arena, home ground of Buriram United. On big match days, many guests say they can walk from their room to the stadium gate in five minutes, with none of the scramble for parking or the post-game traffic crawl. The Chang International Circuit is a short drive away too, making this a tidy base for both football and motorsport fans.

The 152 rooms come in several types, from the 28 sqm Superior up to the 36 sqm Deluxe Terrace with a private balcony, the 44 sqm Loft Studio and the 67 sqm One-Bedroom Superior for families. Guests praise the spacious, clean rooms and comfortable beds, along with small touches like the in-room JBL speaker that several reviews mention. The design is clean and modern in warm tones, suiting both business travellers and holidaymakers.
"Here for a match at Chang Arena — just a five-minute walk from the hotel to the stadium, and straight back to bed after the final whistle. No hunting for a taxi. Brilliant value on a match day."

The shared facilities are well covered for this price point. There are two pools, both outdoor and indoor, a wide terrace to sit out on, a 24-hour gym for late-night workouts, plus a steam room and a massage room. The pools are a particular hit with families, as children can splash about easily and the atmosphere around the water is quieter than at city-centre hotels.

Breakfast at the Bistro@M restaurant draws consistent praise. The spread is varied, both Thai and international, with fresh ingredients and good flavours, and many guests say it offers more choice than they'd expect from a provincial hotel. The restaurant is open for lunch and dinner too, handy on nights you'd rather not head out, since dining options around the hotel are thinner than in the city centre.

Staff are what reviews single out most on the positive side. The reception team is friendly, helpful and attentive, especially during the busy check-in rush on match days. The trade-off for that next-to-the-stadium location is being a fair way from the city centre and night markets — without your own car you'll rely on Grab or the hotel shuttle to get into town, a point some guests flag.

To be honest, Modena by Fraser Buriram is best for people coming chiefly for the Chang venues. If your trip leans on city life — strolling markets, eating in town every night — the stadium-side location means more back-and-forth by car. But if the goal is football, racing, or simply a quiet, clean hotel with a pool at an accessible price, it does that well and offers good value, reflected in consistently high review scores.

A tip from reading the reviews: on big match days or race events, rooms fill up fast and rates climb. Standard rooms usually run around THB 1,290–2,500/night, but peak dates can be several times higher. If you know the match date, book ahead and choose free cancellation first.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Modena by Fraser Buriram

faq.q: How close is Modena by Fraser Buriram to Chang Arena?
faq.a: The hotel sits right next to Chang Arena, a few minutes' walk from the lobby to the stadium gate. The Chang International Circuit is about a 10-minute drive away. It's one of the closest hotels to the venues in Buriram, ideal for match days and race weekends.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types at Modena by Fraser Buriram?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. THB 1,290/night for the 28 sqm Superior Room with breakfast included. Larger options include the Deluxe Terrace (36 sqm), the Loft Studio (44 sqm) and the One-Bedroom Superior (67 sqm) for families. Rates during stadium events run higher than ordinary nights, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What facilities does Modena by Fraser Buriram have?
faq.a: It has two pools (outdoor and indoor), a 24-hour gym, a steam room, a massage room and the Bistro@M restaurant, plus free parking and a shuttle service. Wi-Fi is free in all rooms. It's a 4-star Frasers Hospitality hotel with 152 rooms.

faq.q: Who is Modena by Fraser Buriram best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for fans coming for football at Chang Arena, racing at the Chang circuit, or families who want a pool. The location is right by the venues and the rooms are spacious and clean. If you'd rather stay central to walk the markets every night, plan for some driving back and forth.

faq.q: Is it convenient to stay here without a car?
faq.a: The stadium-side location is a fair way from the city centre and night markets. Without your own car, check the hotel shuttle or plan to use Grab to reach town. On match days, though, this is the most convenient spot since you can simply walk to the stadium.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: Off-peak, one to two weeks ahead is usually enough. But when Buriram United have a big home match or there's a race event, book several weeks in advance, as rooms fill fast and rates climb sharply. Choose free cancellation first if your plans aren't firm.
